summary: Server one-frame component on an inventory: treasure items to add to it. Born together with GeneratedAsTreasure and EntityMergeEvent when containers/levels generate treasure (dialogues, events, container tests). Read by esv::inventory::InteractionRequestSystem::GatherRequests (log 'Adding treasure %s to %s (trade treasure: %s)').

fields.name: Item
fields.evidence: GatherRequests (EoCServer.dll+0xFC7B40) iterates the component's array with stride 0x10, logs element+0 as the treasure entity in 'Adding treasure %s to %s' and queues it as a member-add request.

fields.name: IsTradeTreasure
fields.evidence: Same loop: '(trade treasure: %s)' prints GetBoolStr of byte element+8; the add type becomes (element[8] != 0) + 1.

fields.name: Treasure
